description: This course introduces students to the fundamentals of programming through hands-on laboratory sessions. Topics include Python syntax and semantics; basic data types, operators, and expressions; control structures such as if-else and loops; functions and modules; file input/output operations; exception handling; and standard libraries. Students will also explore algorithm design using pseudocode and flowcharts; basic data structures like arrays and lists; and fundamental algorithms such as sorting and searching. The course emphasizes practical implementation using Python 3.10 and adheres to industry standards for code quality and readability.

clos.text: Define Python syntax elements including variables, data types, and operators.
Describe the structure and functionality of control flow statements in Python.
Explain the principles of function definition, parameters, and return values in Python.
Apply fundamental algorithms such as binary search and bubble sort to solve computational problems.
Implement basic data structures like lists and dictionaries using Python's standard library.
